text: The room upstairs where Straker lies
why: At ¶73 Gregory confirms Straker's body 'lies upstairs' at the house. The label's 'room' is a reasonable reading of 'upstairs'.
At ¶73 Gregory says 'The inquest is to-morrow,' which is the stated time of the inquest.

text: When Straker's body was brought back to his house
why: At ¶72 Holmes asks whether Straker was brought back to the house, and ¶73 confirms it.
